surface.notes: The release is one authored simulation. Internal build gates remain available only to development tooling.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
No development gate is persisted as a normal player preference.
A development comparison may temporarily alter presentation only when the build is clearly labeled non-release evidence.

accessibilityPolicy.rule: An accessibility control may be public only when it does not disable/rebalance simulation authority or reveal exact hidden state contrary to the authored presentation.
